key_points: Nvidia’s strong earnings and higher long-term memory supply commitments are a near-term positive for MU.
GF Securities cut NAND price forecasts and warned of a glut, reinforcing 2028 memory-cycle concerns.
MU had already fallen nearly 19% in a month, creating a lower-expectations setup for positive AI-related news.
Much of the coverage is analyst commentary/stock-picking rather than new fundamental disclosures.
Net effect is modestly constructive, not thesis-changing; sustainability depends on memory pricing and contract visibility.
